analysis:
## Technical analysis (July 6, 2026 — official US close)

**Trend:** NVDA is above its 200-day SMA (~$190.32), which keeps the structural uptrend technically intact. The stock is in a $192–$200 consolidation box that it has failed to break above in three consecutive tests (July 1 official close was $200.09 entering the position; every session since has been below the $200 gate). The structure is neutral-to-deteriorating within a technically intact long-term uptrend.

**Momentum:** RSI at 44.57 is neutral/mild-sell territory — not oversold (no bounce signal), not overbought (no reversal signal). The RSI read provides no directional edge; relative performance and volume tell a clearer story.

**Pattern:** A descending resistance pattern has formed at $197–$200 across three tests: OTC $200.06 (July 5, faded to $194.83); today's intraday high $197.55 (faded to $195.84). Each recovery attempt reaches a lower high. This is classic distribution, occurring just above the $195 stop threshold.

**Volume — the most important signal today:** 56.51M shares (35% of 160.2M average) is the critical data point. On a day the SOX gained 3.2% with AMD running +7.7%, NVDA's recovery from $194.00 to $195.84 on 56.51M shares shows no institutional participation. In strong NVDA sessions, volume runs 130–200M+. The recovery from the intraday low on 35% of average volume is not institutional accumulation — it is retail stop-hunting and short covering. Volume is DIVERGING bearishly from even the modest price recovery.

**Strongest support — $194.00 (today's intraday low):** Buyers appeared at $194.00 and defended the close above $195. This is now confirmed tested support. The caveat: buyers were defending a news-catalyst stop-hunt (Kyber denial drove the bounce). If $194.00 is re-tested on a neutral news day, the defense may be weaker.

**Strongest resistance — $200 (Gate 3 / seller zone):** Three consecutive failed tests: (1) July 5 OTC $200.06 faded to $194.83; (2) July 6 intraday $197.55 faded to $195.84. The Kyber delay narrative adds fundamental justification to what was already strong technical resistance at the $200 round number with elevated call OI. This is the highest-confidence resistance in the framework: sellers at $197–$200 are specifically identified, motivated (trapped buyers and fresh Kyber shorts), and have proven capable of absorbing the SPCX inclusion mechanical bid.

**Decision points:** The framework is now binary at a higher level: Can NVDA close above $200 on July 7 or beyond (Gate 3)? If yes → full-size add. If no → hold half-size through August 26 earnings. The Kyber narrative is the key variable — it need not be proven true; the uncertainty alone suppresses institutional buying in the $197–$200 zone.

**Invalidation of the bear read:** A July 7 close above $200 on volume >150M shares, ideally accompanied by a tier-1 analyst note confirming Kyber delay is non-material to 2026-2027 earnings, would invalidate the distribution pattern and activate Gate 3. Absent both volume confirmation and Kyber clarity, the $200 level remains a seller-defended ceiling.
